top_signals.summary: The UK’s progress towards its ambitious housebuilding target has been dealt another blow after the fiscal watchdog said housing output is set to slow for another three years.  The Office for Budget Responsibility (OBR) said housing delivery will fall to 229,000 this year, to 221,000 the following year and to 219,000 in the year 2027-28. top_signals.summary: The FEC reported an “electronic filing system outage” on Tuesday as groups are expected to ramp up spending before the US midterm elections.

top_signals.title: Baker Hughes 3Q EPS Beat Falls Short of High Bar
top_signals.summary: Baker Hughes beats Wall Street’s profit expectations but falls short of the high bar investors had set heading into earnings. CEO Lorenzo Simonelli discusses the third-quarter results and outlook on Bloomberg Open Interest. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Mixed outlook for energy expenditures this winter
top_signals.summary: We expect energy expenditures this winter to vary because of diverging trends in energy prices among fuels and regional variation in forecast temperatures. We expect that lower prices for natural gas and propane will drive decreases in expenditures this year for the half of U.S. households heating with those fuels. Higher prices for electricity and heating oil drive increased expenditures for households heating with those fuels in our forecast.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
